m: वृण् cl. 8. P. Ā. वृणोति, वृणुते, to consume, eat, Dhātup. xxx, 6 (Vop.); cl. 6. P. वृणति, to please, gratify, exhilarate, ib. xxviii, 40.
a: वृण् — {vI.v} {c8c} U. (वृणोति, वृणुते) To eat, consume. {vII.v} {c6c} P. (वृणति) To give pleasure, gratify.

s: da Ya u Bakze । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tanA॰uBa॰-saka॰-sew । ktrAvew .) da Ya, vfRoti varRoti vfRute varRute । u, varRitvA vftvA । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: BakzarRe tanA॰ uBa॰ saka॰ saw । vfRoti varRoti vfRute avarRIt avarRizwa । udit ktvA vew ।
